name: Kanemi Co., Ltd.
summary: Kanemi Co., Ltd. operates retail stores in Japan. The company operates through Tenant and Retail segments. The Tenant segment operates prepared food stores, sushi specialty stores, and Western restaurants in supermarkets, department stores, station buildings, and other commercial facilities. The Retail segment is involved in the production and supply of bento boxes, rice, and side dishes to franchise and convenience stores. Kanemi Co., Ltd. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
